rules: One task per session; read the THEORY.md section named in the task before editing.
Never merge main, never force-push; push research branches only.
CARGO_TARGET_DIR per worktree; run cargo clean -p rodas5p-integrators -p vigilode after switching worktrees on a shared target.
Without --no-fail-fast cargo stops at the first failing test binary.
Performance verdicts need owner-host preregistered cells; host wall time is diagnostic only.
Cargo.lock changes only through cargo itself; never hand-edit it.
research/LEDGER.jsonl is append-only, rows only via the DESIGN.md 13.2 script.

SL-N12.what: BandedKernel::FixedWidth2 runs the V21 tight-kernel arithmetic on fixed row offsets; the facade's (2,2) banded routes (endpoint and dense output) choose it; other bands below BANDED_SLICES_MIN_HALF_WIDTH stay on Indexed (V22 measured Slices slower there).

SL-N6.what: feature research-gates in rodas5p-core, rodas5p-integrators, vigilode-coupled; self dev-dependencies keep every own test target building; rodas5p-fair-ab and rodas5p-cli enable it; five modules reclassified to the default build because default routes import them.
SL-N6.open: owner-host compile-time cells and a CI feature matrix (KS-N2)

SL-N5.what: rustfft 6.4.1 (MIT OR Apache-2.0) in the workspace; vigilode::spatial::SeparableStages and VigilODE::solve_separable; exact Fourier stage solves on the sphere and the periodic box with inertia and mass certificates and a Verified mode.

tasks.title: Owner-host preregistered cells for the (2,2) fixed-offset default route
tasks.question: Does the SL-N12 acceptance hold on the owner host: instructions <= 0.60 and cycles <= 0.80 of the Indexed route at n >= 1e4?
tasks.implementation: Run banded_kernel_entry_identity::measure_fixed_width_against_indexed_whole_solves under perf stat (instructions, cycles) on the pinned toolchain, three times, nothing else running. Record JSON lines and the toolchain.
acceptance: both ratios inside the preregistered bounds at n = 1e4 and 1e5
the identity assertions of the measurement pass
tasks.kill: cycles ratio above 0.95 at both sizes
tasks.fallback: keep the promotion (bits are identical) and record the negative performance cell

tasks.title: Feature matrix in CI and compile-time cells for research-gates
tasks.question: Does every job build and test both with and without research-gates, and what is the owner-host compile time of each?
tasks.implementation: Owner adds a job that runs cargo build -p vigilode (no feature) and cargo test -p rodas5p-integrators (feature through the self dev-dependency). Agents may not edit .github/**.
acceptance: compile seconds recorded for both legs
tasks.kill: a default facade route needs a gated module
tasks.fallback: reclassify the module in the inventory (as done for five modules here)

tasks.title: Owner-host cells for the separable route against the shipped matrix-free route
tasks.question: Is the separable route cheaper per accepted step than the shipped route and than GMRES with the longitude preconditioner at matched achieved error on 32x64, 64x128 and 128x256?
tasks.implementation: Run both ignored diagnostics of crates/vigilode/tests/spatial_separable.rs three times on the owner host with perf stat; record JSON lines.
acceptance: separable wall time and instructions below the shipped route on every grid
relative error within a factor 10 of the shipped route
mass drift <= 1e-13 on the separable route
tasks.kill: slower than GMRES with the longitude preconditioner on every grid at the stage level
tasks.fallback: keep the route opt-in; record the negative cells

tasks.title: Mode-parallel and ring-pair-parallel separable solves
tasks.question: Does running the floor(np/2)+1 mode systems and the nt/2 ring-pair FFTs on rayon give the same bits as the serial solve and a wall-time gain on 2 and 12 workers (THEORY.md §6)?
tasks.implementation: Add SpatialRows to SeparableStages; chunk modes and ring pairs with par_chunks_mut; identical per-chunk arithmetic so the bits do not depend on the worker count.
acceptance: serial == parallel bits on every grid of spatial_separable
owner-host wall time <= 0.6 of serial on 12 workers at 128x256

tasks.title: Stiffness certificate in the automatic router
tasks.question: Should the automatic router use SeparableStages::spectral_bounds (THEORY.md §5.3) to choose between DOPRI5 and the separable RODAS5P route when a DiffusionGrid problem declares its stages?
tasks.implementation: A declared SeparableStages on the problem (new optional field) lets the preflight compare 6 T rho_bar / beta RHS calls against the measured per-step cost of the separable route.
acceptance: the choice matches the cheaper route on the owner-host cells of KS-N3 and on three non-stiff grids
tasks.kill: the certificate picks the slower route on any preregistered cell
tasks.fallback: keep the user-selected entry point only

tasks.title: Per-ring linear rates c_r and GMRES with the separable preconditioner
tasks.question: THEORY.md §8: a ring-constant diagonal commutes with Z_np, so c_r per ring keeps exactness; for longitude-dependent reactions, is GMRES preconditioned by W_sep cheaper than Verified defect correction?
tasks.implementation: Replace the scalar c by a per-ring vector in the mode systems; add a Preconditioner impl of the separable solve for the matrix-free route's GMRES.
acceptance: Verified corrections per solve and GMRES iterations reported on the T5 problem
tasks.kill: neither variant beats Verified defect correction on the T5 problem

tasks.title: Two-for-one real FFT on the periodic box
tasks.question: The box solve transforms a real field as complex data; does pairing rows (the involution of §2.3) halve its FFT work without changing the backward error?
tasks.implementation: Pack rows y and y+1 as u + i v along x, separate by R Z(m) = conj Z(nx-m), transform the Hermitian half along y and z.
acceptance: box stage solve time <= 0.6 of the current one at 256x256

tasks.title: Field-of-values replacement for advection (open)
tasks.question: THEORY.md §8: for non-normal J (advection-diffusion with ring-constant velocity), what replaces the inertia certificate and the contractivity bound?
tasks.implementation: Theory first: numerical range of the per-mode tridiagonal blocks, then a computable certificate.
acceptance: a stated, checked bound on 3 small grids
tasks.kill: no computable bound tighter than Gershgorin
